Data:Interest.heart.json.label: Interested in Heart
Data:Interest.heart.json.desc: Someone is interested in healing and protection. [The Heart is the principle that continues and preserves.]

Data:Interest.knock.json.label: Interested in Knock
Data:Interest.knock.json.desc: Someone is interested in unsealing. [The Knock is the principle that opens doors and unseams barriers.]

Data:Interest.lantern.json.label: Interested in Lantern
Data:Interest.lantern.json.desc: Someone is interested in revelations. [Lantern is the principle of the secret place sometimes called the House of the Sun, and of the light above it.]

Data:Interest.moon.json.label: Interested in Moon
Data:Interest.moon.json.desc: Someone is interested in hidden things. [The nocturnal, the forgotten.]

Data:Interest.moth.json.label: Interested in Moth
Data:Interest.moth.json.desc: Someone is interested in the unexpected. [Moth is the wild and perilous principle of chaos and yearning.]

Data:Interest.nectar.json.label: Interested in Nectar
Data:Interest.nectar.json.desc: Someone is interested in the roots of things. [Long ago, some called this principle Blood.]

Data:Interest.rose.json.label: Interested in Rose
Data:Interest.rose.json.desc: Someone is interested in horizons. [Complexities, exploration, hope.]

Data:Interest.scale.json.label: Interested in Scale
Data:Interest.scale.json.desc: Someone is interested in ancient profundities. [What is left of the crude powers of the deep earth.]

Data:Interest.sky.json.label: Interested in Sky
Data:Interest.sky.json.desc: Someone is interested in the songs of earth and heaven. [The old powers of the sky are often overlooked by the impatient.]

Data:Interest.winter.json.label: Interested in Winter
Data:Interest.winter.json.desc: ...? [Winter is the principle of silence, of endings, and of those things that are not quite dead.]

Data:Intoxicating.json.label: Intoxicating
Data:Intoxicating.json.desc: 'Quick, bring me a beaker of wine, so that I may wet my mind and say something clever.' - Aristophanes

Data:Introduction.blacksmith.start.json.label: An Old Friend's Address
Data:Introduction.blacksmith.start.json.desc: Denzil is the blacksmith of Brancrug Village. I remember him from the War. If he remembers me, I can find shelter beneath his roof - once I've reached Brancrug Village.

Data:Introduction.coffinmaker.start.json.label: An Old Friend's Address
Data:Introduction.coffinmaker.start.json.desc: Mr Kille is the coffinmaker of Brancrug Village. I once wrote kindly of his poetry. His home is always open to me (though he's asked me never to mention poetry in front of Mrs Kille). I can find shelter for tonight under their roof - once I've reached Brancrug Village.

Data:Introduction.json.label: An Introduction
Data:Introduction.json.desc: Even in this remote place, one can meet new friends, or make new enemies.

Data:Introduction.midwife.start.json.label: An Old Friend's Address
Data:Introduction.midwife.start.json.desc: Mrs Kille is the handywoman - the midwife - of Brancrug village. I knew her long ago in Paris, when her surname was not 'Kille' but 'Raveline', and her sister was a viscountess. Her home is always open to me (though she's asked me not to bring up the title thing when Mr Kille's around). I can find shelter for tonight under their roof - once I've reached Brancrug Village.

Data:Introduction.rector.start.json.label: An Old Friend's Address
Data:Introduction.rector.start.json.desc: I first heard of Brancrug through its Rector, Reverend Timothy. For years now I've been exchanging letters with him. I can find shelter for tonight under his roof - once I've reached Brancrug Village. [The Rector can also introduce you to other villagers.]

Data:Invincible.audacity.json.Label: Invincible Audacity
Data:Invincible.audacity.json.Desc: 'A general says: when I make the right choice, I win. An Illuminate says: when I win, I determine which choice was the right one.' - Natalia Brulleau

Data:Invitation.json.label: An Invitation
Data:Invitation.json.desc: If I take this to the Post Office - then if I have money for a stamp - if the recipient is at home - if they don't have other business - if they aren't even now leaving Brancrug - then this will bring them here.

Data:January.sanguinary.json.Label: January Sanguinary
Data:January.sanguinary.json.Desc: Also called sanguis saltandis or, by the ignorantly superstitious, 'true blood of St Januarius'.

xexts.scrutiny: 'And so it will not, will not, will not stop dancing.' [With Keeper-level Heart recipes, this can be crafted from Gideon's Soaks.]

Data:Jar.snootle.json.Label: Snootle Jar
Data:Jar.snootle.json.Desc: Useful for calcination, purification, alteration; invaluable for snootlery.

xexts.scrutiny: In these dark days, true snootlery is rarely to be found, but I am now in a position to correct that.

Data:Journal.archaeologist.json.label: Sand-Scarred Journal
Data:Journal.archaeologist.json.desc: I am the Librarian of Hush House, and this journal will record what arose from my Crime and my Curse. [The Archaeologist's dearest wish, when they came to the House, was to record a History where their crime could be forgiven... or redefined. But you can complete the game by recording any History. You might wish to begin your studies with the Skolekosophy Wisdom.]

Data:Journal.archaeologist.unc.json.label: Scarred Book
Data:Journal.archaeologist.unc.json.desc: Goatskin? Antelope? Some scarred leather that catches at my memory. I should know.

Data:Journal.artist.json.label: Bee-Silk Journal
Data:Journal.artist.json.desc: 'Picasso? I'll give you Picasso.' [The Artist came to Hush House to shape and share a History of primal, ultimate, unprecedented experience; but you can complete the game by recording any History. You might wish to begin your studies with the Bosk Wisdom.]

Data:Journal.artist.unc.json.label: Silken Book
Data:Journal.artist.unc.json.desc: The binding is unusual - and half-familiar - some kind of silk? It's survived its soaking remarkably well.

Data:Journal.cartographer.json.label: Serpentskin Journal
Data:Journal.cartographer.json.desc: I am the Librarian of Hush House, and this journal will be my Perpetual Map. [The Cartographer's dearest wish, when they came to the House, was to chart a new History in which their impossible map would be possible; but you can complete the game by recording any History. You might wish to begin your studies with the Nyctodromy Wisdom.]

Data:Journal.cartographer.unc.json.label: Scaled Book
Data:Journal.cartographer.unc.json.desc: The scaled binding has survived the soaking well enough.

Data:Journal.executioner.json.label: Horned Journal
Data:Journal.executioner.json.desc: I laid so many of those uncanny things to rest. I thought it was right. I fear now it was not. I am the Librarian of Hush House, and here I will ensure they will be remembered. [The Executioner's dearest wish, when they came to the House, was to record a new History which will atone for their crimes; but you can complete the game by recording any History. You might wish to begin your studies with the Preservation Wisdom.]

Data:Journal.executioner.unc.json.label: Mottled Book
Data:Journal.executioner.unc.json.desc: The cover is unusual. Horn? Bakelite? Chitin? I should be able to remember.

Data:Journal.generic.start.json.label: A Drowned Book
Data:Journal.generic.start.json.desc: The one possession I kept from the shipwreck. It must be important to me. [The Aspects below tell you more about how and where you can use this item. Mouse over them to learn more.]

Data:Journal.json.label: Journal
Data:Journal.json.desc: I began before this book, but it'll end when I do.

Data:Journal.magnate.json.label: Silver-Bound Journal
Data:Journal.magnate.json.desc: I was rich; but something was missing. I am no longer rich... and still, something is missing. Hush House is a place of conclusions, and here, as Librarian, I may find mine. [The Magnate came to the House to conclude a History where they will find peace; but you can complete the game by recording any History. You might wish to begin your studies with the Hushery Wisdom.]

Data:Journal.magnate.unc.json.label: Silvery Book
Data:Journal.magnate.unc.json.desc: Is that real silver? I feel that it should be. I should remember.

Data:Journal.prodigal.json.label: Hammered Copper Journal
Data:Journal.prodigal.json.desc: I've crossed three oceans and almost drowned in one. Now I am the Librarian of Hush House. Perhaps here I will be safe from my parents; but I can't take that for granted. [The Prodigal's dearest wish is sanctuary - as Librarian, or in a History where things are different;but you can complete the game by recording any History. You might wish to begin your studies with the Ithastry Wisdom.]

Data:Journal.prodigal.unc.json.label: Coppery Book
Data:Journal.prodigal.unc.json.desc: The unusual metal binding is untouched by the sea.
